answer: An opportunity-cost bond calibrates collateral to stake multiplied by a zero-knowledge verifiable delay, making any Sybil multiplication lock capital that exceeds the expected reward and yielding a strictly negative attack utility. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix assigns penalties proportional to deviation, eliminating profitable deviations and enforcing a strict Nash equilibrium. Thus the adversary cannot forge identities without incurring a shale of lost stake, preserving the protocol's meadow of honest validators.
